scientific_integrity.limitations: Only rank-one positive-semidefinite updates of the identity and symmetric positive diagonal scaling; no uniqueness claim for optimal diagonal matrices; no end-to-end convergence or runtime guarantees.
scientific_integrity.prior_art_risks: General numerical optimization of diagonal scaling is well established. Earlier structural results on optimally conditioned block matrices may include implications not accessible in their abstracts; independent historical novelty determination remains open.
scientific_integrity.statement: Complete analytic proof for all real vectors in every dimension at least two and all positive diagonal congruences; supplementary numerical and exact-symbolic checks are not used to infer infinite quantifiers.

title: Exact diagonal preconditioning of a rank-one update: a sharp dominant-coordinate transition
